notes: Merged 'Care pendant' and 'Fall detector' into 'Personal alarm'. Pendant, wrist, automatic fall detector and GPS are now types. All four Tunstall models are kept, and the duplicated 'Tunstall Lifeline wearables' range now appears once. Merged 'Medical ID bracelet' and 'Medical ID tag' into 'Medical ID'. Bracelet, tag, card and keyring are now types. The five American Medical ID SKUs (Action Pro, Eternity, Lynx Shine, Stainless Steel Classic, Stainless Steel Dog Tag) are cut to one brand-level range. 'Wandering detector' is kept with its one model and has door-alarm and motion-sensor types. Each kind keeps an old source URL; for Medical ID I used the American Medical ID home page rather than the bracelet listing. Brand-level ranges for Lifeline24, Medical Guardian, MedicAlert and ROAD iD were added only because the shelf brief names them. Their range labels and maker names have not been checked against a retrieved source, so they need checking before publication. No archetypes, new kinds or brand-register entries were added.
